### 2. Hero h2 line-height
File: `src/components/home/hero.tsx`
- Hero h2 has `line-height: 50px`
- Webflow `.heading-2` is `line-height: 45px`
- Fix to `leading-[45px]` or `lineHeight: "45px"`

### 3. How It Works h2 line-height
File: `src/components/home/how-it-works.tsx`
- h2 has `line-height: 48px`
- Webflow `.heading-2` is `line-height: 45px`
- Fix to 45px

### 4. Pricing h2 margin-bottom
File: `src/components/home/pricing-section.tsx`
- h2 has `margin-bottom: 12px`
- Webflow `.heading-2.margin-bottom-24px` is `margin-bottom: 24px`
- Fix to 24px

### 5. FAQ heading size
File: `src/components/home/faq-section.tsx`
- h2 "Frequently Asked Questions" is `32px`
- Webflow `.heading-2` is `40px` with `line-height: 45px`
- Fix to `font-size: 40px; line-height: 45px`

### 6. Section padding — use percentage not fixed px
ALL section files in `src/components/home/`:
- Currently using `px-[72px]` or `pl-72 pr-72`
- Webflow uses `padding-left: 5%; padding-right: 5%` which is responsive
- Change ALL section side padding from fixed `72px` to `px-[5%]`
- Check these files: pain-points.tsx, resolution-banner.tsx, built-for.tsx, benefits-grid.tsx, how-it-works.tsx, pricing-section.tsx, comparison.tsx, faq-section.tsx

### 7. Section paragraph font-size
Several sections show `paragraph.center` at `16px` but Webflow `.paragraph.center` is `font-size: 18px (var(--para))`.
- Grep for `text-base` or `text-[16px]` on section subtitle paragraphs
- Change body/subtitle paragraphs under h2 headings to `text-[18px]` (not all paragraphs, only the main section subtitles that match `.paragraph.center`)

### 8. Heading margin-bottom consistency
Webflow `.heading-2.margin-bottom-24px` = `margin-bottom: 24px`
- Check ALL section h2s have `mb-6` (24px) or `margin-bottom: 24px`
- Pain points h2 shows `mb:20px` — fix to 24px
- Built-for h2 shows `mb:20px` — fix to 24px
- Benefits h2 shows `mb:20px` — fix to 24px

### EXECUTION ORDER:
1. Read each file
2. Make the exact edit
3. Move to next file
4. No verification needed — just fix everything

DO NOT PLAN. START EDITING IMMEDIATELY.
